# browserbuddy install-host

Install the native-messaging host manifest so the browser can spawn the BrowserBuddy host (which serves MCP over loopback HTTP).

## Flags

| Name | Short | Type | Default | Env | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--browser` |  | str |  |  | Which browser to install for. "chrome" covers the whole Chromium family. |
| `--user-data-dir` |  | str |  |  | Chrome only: the browser profile directory (--user-data-dir). Defaults to the first Chrome or Chromium profile directory that exists under your home. |
| `--home` |  | str |  |  | Firefox only: the HOME whose .mozilla/native-messaging-hosts receives the manifest. Defaults to your home directory. |
| `--data-dir` |  | str |  |  | Directory the installed host will use for event logs, demonstrations and its endpoint files. Defaults to server/data inside the installed package. |
